candidate.raw_translation: Wannan wani ƙididdigar da aka sauƙaƙa, ba wani kyauta ko alkawari na biyan kuɗin. Yana amfani da aikace-aikacen ZXQPH0000QXZ / ZXQPH0001QXZ PIA kuma yana tsammanin shekarun ritaya na ZXQPH0002QXZ. Ba ya ƙididdige AIME daga albashi, ƙara ƙarin COLAs, bincika kuɗaɗen aiki ko kuɗaɗen shiga, ko nau'ikan harajin, kuɗaɗe na Medicare, fa'idodin iyali, matsalolin ko fa'idodin masu tsira. Bincika sanarwar tsaron zamantakewar ku ta ofishinku kuma ku yi amfani da ƙididdigar SSA don ƙididdigar mutum. Wannan kayan aiki yana ba da bayanai na yau da kullun, ba shawarwari na kuɗi ba.
candidate.source: This is a simplified estimate, not an award or promise of payment. It uses the official 2025/2026 PIA formula and assumes a full retirement age of 67. It does not calculate AIME from wages, add later COLAs, verify work credits or earnings, or model taxes, Medicare premiums, family benefits, disability or survivor benefits. Check your official Social Security statement and use SSA’s estimator for a personal estimate. This tool gives general information, not financial advice.
